prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1198; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

This summary describes the course of care for a patient presenting with cervical strain (whiplash-type injury) following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches radiating to the base of the skull, with reduced cervical range of motion on initial examination, particularly in rotation and extension.

Over the course of 15 visits, treatment included a combination of manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise for cervical stabilization, and modalities for pain control as clinically indicated. Range of motion and pain scores were tracked at each visit. The patient showed steady improvement in mobility and a gradual reduction in headache frequency through the middle phase of care, with some plateau in neck extension noted in later sessions.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full cervical range of motion, minimal residual tenderness, and independent use of a home exercise program. Occasional stiffness with prolonged positioning persists but does not significantly limit daily activities or work duties. Ongoing self-management and aPRN follow-up plan have been recommended.
